message:
feat(tactics): induct over constrained indices with checked conditional hypotheses

Generalize the source major and its dependent context instead of capturing
the whole input in recursive hypotheses. Reuse the existing checked
index-equation backend for fixed, repeated, shared and dependent indices.
Keep child-index equations as real premises and preserve unreachable-branch
proofs, lets, shadowing, small elimination and hidden cases hypotheses.

Add eighteen source regressions and a real installed CLI example covering
positive-length vectors, dependent indexed copy, multiple recursive fields,
changing accumulators, invalid source obligations and failure recovery.
No kernel change, new axiom or admission authority. Full scoped tests,
Clippy and workspace compilation repeat before non-forced main publication.
Related workstreams: fln-kpd, fln-qb5.
